Run Stage 1 + Stage 2 Pareto query optimization

Source: R/06_optimizer.R
optimize_queries.Rd

Run Stage 1 + Stage 2 Pareto query optimization

Usage

optimize_queries(
  seeds_df,
  terms_df,
  blocks,
  config = list(),
  min_recall = 0.6,
  max_hits = 2000,
  max_evals = 60L,
  max_gs_chars = 256L,
  discover_exclusions = TRUE,
  email = NULL,
  ncbi_key = NULL,
  cache_dir = ".cache",
  use_cache = TRUE,
  eval_pubmed_fn = pubmed_eval_query,
  pm_esearch_fn = pubmed_esearch,
  pm_efetch_fn = pubmed_efetch,
  progress_cb = NULL
)

Arguments

seeds_df

Enriched seeds tibble.

terms_df

Scored candidate terms tibble.

blocks

Concept blocks list.

config

Optional config list.

min_recall

Minimum desired seed recall (0..1).

max_hits

Optional maximum PubMed hit count threshold.

max_evals

Maximum live API query evaluations.

max_gs_chars

Maximum Google Scholar character limit (default 256).

discover_exclusions

Logical; whether to mine non-seed PubMed results for exclusion hints.

email

Optional email for NCBI polite pool.

ncbi_key

Optional NCBI API key.

cache_dir

Cache directory path.

use_cache

Logical; whether to read/write cache.

eval_pubmed_fn

Function `(pm_query, seed_pmids, ...)` returning `pm_hits`, `pm_found`, `pm_recall`, `ok`.

pm_esearch_fn

Optional dependency injection for [pubmed_esearch()].

pm_efetch_fn

Optional dependency injection for [pubmed_efetch()].

progress_cb

Optional progress callback function.

Value

Optimization result list containing `eval_df`, `pareto_df`, `exclusion_hints`, `recommended_sig`, `seeds_df`, `blocks`.
